translationRepairs: Welcoming the Spirit — "Supreme Harmony": ah, the Martial Emperor — doubled brilliance is proclaimed.
Welcoming the Spirit — "Supreme Harmony": ah, the Cultured Emperor — doubled brilliance is proclaimed.
Chinese 文皇 is the Cultured/Wen Emperor (Ming Chengzu), not Martial (武); Martial would be 武皇.
Welcoming the Spirit, "Supreme Harmony": ah, the Martial Emperor — doubled brilliance is proclaimed.
Welcoming the Spirit, "Supreme Harmony": ah, the Cultured Emperor — doubled brilliance is proclaimed.
Literal English likewise mistranslates 文皇 as Martial Emperor.
